title: OTHRYS OS structural substrate
goal: Establish a Panda-class declarative project/workstation substrate over the existing V2 governed motor without creating a second execution engine.
laws: V2 remains canonical execution and evidence authority.
Project, Work, authority, capability, model, knowledge and integration structure must be declarative and inspectable.
The OS projection is read-only and grants no execution authority.
Existing Command Deck API compatibility must be preserved.
No PandaOS runtime dependency or branding.
